purpose: Shows the product's logo and name, with an optional version Badge, in app and marketing headers and footers. Wrap it in a link to make it go home.

notFor.case: The brand block at the top of a Sidebar.
A person's or organisation's picture on its own.
A clickable home control by itself; it is not focusable.

Default.visual: Logo, then the name in Content/primary, then the optional version Badge. sm in app headers, default in marketing headers and footers.

a11y.keyboard: Not focusable. When wrapped in a link, Tab reaches the link and Enter follows it.
notes: Decorative on its own; the link around it gives the accessible name (for example "Escala home").
